dedupe_keys.name: japan road traffic census fy2021 全国道路 街路交通情勢調査 general traffic volume survey results

description: The national road and street traffic situation survey (road traffic census) is MLIT's periodic survey of Japanese road traffic. The FY2021 page provides general traffic volume survey tables: summary tables by prefecture and road type for the number of sections, length, road facility length, traffic volume and travel speed, each in PDF, Excel and CSV with a CSV header format, plus location basic tables and hourly traffic tables, a guide to reading the results and a web map for visualisation. The e-Stat entry for the survey states its purpose: to understand current road traffic and obtain basic material for regional transport and road plans; e-Stat API use needs an application ID. Coverage: Japan's national and local road sections. Format and access: free downloads. Licence and cost: free; no licence is stated on the MLIT page. Caveats: Japanese only, and definitions must be read before use. It supports network flow and capacity planning of Japanese roads. It relates to JR East railway GTFS data and GB road traffic counts in the catalogue.
